{{Quote|Princess, we're picking up a ship approaching rapidly. We suspect it's ''hostile''.''"<br />"''An Imperial ship? How did they find us?''"<br />"''Just chance. We make a pretty big blip on the scanners. We're diverting to ''intercept''.|Alliance Fleet commander and Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="SOTE1" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Alliance Fleet]] engaged in a '''skirmish''' with an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] at [[Haven (rendezvous point)|Haven]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion's]] secret deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] rendezvous point, in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. Driven from their [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] [[Echo Base/Legends|fortress]] in the face of overwhelming Imperial might, the surviving Rebel forces regrouped with the tattered remnants of the Alliance Fleet at a point far beyond the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Galactic Rim]], where they believed the Empire would not track them. The battered Rebel Alliance desperately sought sanctuary and [[Time/Legends|time]] to recoup its staggering losses, as did [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], recovering with the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] from his recent [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|lightsaber duel]] with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].

Although Haven was remote, the Imperial [[Strike-class medium cruiser|Strike cruiser]] had discovered the Alliance Fleet by chance. The Rebels responded quickly by [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] the Strike [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser's]] transmissions and sending [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and the elite [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] to destroy the enemy [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], lest it escape to reveal their position. Flying in their [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]], the Rogues had little trouble dispatching the Strike cruiser's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] complement before eliminating the cruiser itself with a flurry of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]]. Nevertheless, with its secrecy compromised, the fleet soon broke formation and headed back toward the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] plane in search of a new haven.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Good luck, Luke! See you at the rendezvous.|Wedge Antilles, to Luke Skywalker, during the evacuation of Hoth|<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> proved to be the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] worst battlefield defeat of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] overwhelming strength drove the Rebellion from its [[Echo Base/Legends|headquarters]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] personally sought to capture his Rebel [[Gender/Legends|son]], the burgeoning [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Although the [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] defeat cost the Rebellion greatly, the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance leadership]] escaped to regroup with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] at a secret deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] rendezvous point<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> far beyond the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Galactic Rim]],<ref name="C-3PO" /> codenamed [[Haven (rendezvous point)|Haven]].<ref name="Shield of Lies" />

[[File:Rebel_fleet_ESB.jpg|thumb|left|260px|The Alliance Fleet regroups at Haven, the Rebellion's secret rendezvous point.]]
Meanwhile, Vader engineered the Imperial [[Occupation of Bespin|takeover]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] as well as the capture of Rebels [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. But the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord's]] trap failed to net his true prize, Skywalker, who escaped Bespin with Organa and newfound ally [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] after fighting a fierce [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|lightsaber duel]] with Vader in which the young Jedi lost his right [[Limb/Legends|hand]]. The defeated Rebel [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|heroes]] eventually reached the Alliance Fleet at the rendezvous point, and Calrissian soon departed aboard the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|starship]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in search of Solo, whom Vader had given to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] for delivery to [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. Skywalker, Organa, and Calrissian ultimately planned to rendezvous on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="ESB" /> where they knew Fett would eventually arrive to link up with Jabba.<ref name="C-3PO" />

Haven lay at a position above the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] plane, far from any [[Star/Legends|stars]] and from where the Rebels believed the Empire would track them. To reach the rendezvous point was a perilous journey, one that required the Alliance Fleet to ascend out of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]]. Many [[Starship/Legends|ships]] could not survive such a trip, and additional losses were certain. For the Rebellion to take such a risk was a sure sign of desperation but also spoke of its dedication to regroup and continue fighting.<ref name="Of Possible Future">{{StoryCite|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> Yet victory over the Empire seemed hopeless for the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] tattered remnants,<ref name="NEC" /> and the fortunes of war offered the battered Rebels little [[Time/Legends|time]] to regain lost strength.<ref name="C-3PO" />

==The skirmish==
===Strike cruiser inbound===
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Wedge!'' We have confirmation! It's an Imperial ''Strike cruiser!'' It's essential that it does not escape to give away our position!''"<br />"''My friend, you're singing our song!|Alliance Fleet commander and Wedge Antilles|<ref name="SOTE1" />}}
[[File:HavenSkirmishBegins-SOTE1.png|thumb|right|190px|The X-wings of Rogue Squadron prepare to engage the incoming Imperial TIE fighters.]]
Mere [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] had passed since Lando Calrissian's departure from Haven when crisis met the Rebels once more. The surprise appearance of an Imperial [[Unidentified Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]]<ref name="C-3PO" /> sent the Alliance Fleet scrambling to intercept its hostile intruder.<ref name="SOTE1" /> The rendezvous point was indeed remote,<ref name="C-3PO" /> but the Rebel armada registered a sizable anomaly on scanners, and the Imperial vessel had happened upon its position by chance. Still recovering from<ref name="SOTE1" /> emergency [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic]] limb replacement surgery<ref name="C-3PO" /> aboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|medical frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']],<ref name="SOTE1" /><ref name="C-3PO" /> Luke Skywalker was all too eager to jump into his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] and do his duty to help the fleet, but Leia Organa and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] talked him out of it&mdash;not only did he need to rest, but his [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] was undergoing maintenance anyway, rendering the point moot.<ref name="SOTE1" />

Nevertheless, the fleet still boasted the services of the elite [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]],<ref name="SOTE1" /> recently arrived at Haven following action at Hoth.<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" /> Indeed, the fleet held numerical superiority over the [[Strike-class medium cruiser|Strike cruiser]]&mdash;the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''Redemption'', two [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]], three [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]], [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]], and various other vessels, in addition to the Rogues' six X-wings&mdash;but the Rebels' momentary advantage meant nothing if the Imperials were to report their position. Directing the skirmish from aboard one of the fleet's [[Unidentified GR-75 medium transport (Haven)|medium transports]], a [[Unidentified Rebel commander (Haven)|Rebel commander]] impressed upon Rogue Squadron<ref name="SOTE1" /> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]]<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" /> [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] via [[Comlink/Legends|comm]] of the need to eliminate the Strike [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] before it could escape.<ref name="SOTE1" />

===Rogue Squadron to the rescue===
{{Dialogue|Crewman|Those Rogues can mix it!|Navigator|Strike cruiser breaking away! Coordinates oh-three-oh-three-niner!|Commander|He's running for it!|attr=Alliance Fleet personnel|src=<ref name="SOTE1" />}}
As Rogue Squadron zeroed in on the Imperial [[Warship/Legends|warship]], Antilles ordered [[Rogue Five/Legends|Rogue Five]] to sweep wide and for the rest of his [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to stay close to him. The Strike cruiser quickly deployed nine [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] of its own while its [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Haven)|commander]] ordered his pilot to send their coordinates to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader with a message indicating that they had found the Rebel fleet. However, the Rebels had already employed [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] measures, effectively preventing the Imperials from sending out any transmissions. The Rebel commander's medium [[Transport/Legends|transport]] opened the skirmish by destroying one of the oncoming [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] with its [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], and the [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]] was soon joined between Rogue Squadron and the eight remaining Imperial fighters.<ref name="SOTE1" />

[[File:StrikeCruiserDestroyed-SOTE1.png|thumb|left|285px|Rogue Squadron eliminated the Strike cruiser before it could escape to give away the Alliance Fleet's position.]]
To the Rogues' advantage, the TIEs broke formation after making their first pass, allowing the Rebel fighters to take control of the engagement. Antilles' pilots had little trouble sweeping through their Imperial foes, with the exception of [[Rogue Three/Legends|Rogue Three]], who allowed two TIEs to close in on his tail. One of the pursuing TIEs landed a hit on Rogue Three's [[Engine/Legends|engines]], but [[Rogue Two/Legends|Rogue Two]] came to the rescue by piercing one of the TIE's [[Solar collector/Legends|solar panels]] with [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire, which sent the Imperial fighter crashing into its [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]], destroying both in a [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] blaze.<ref name="SOTE1" />

With all the TIEs dispatched, the Strike cruiser turned to run, setting off a chase between the Rebels and the fleeing Imperial vessel with its jeopardizing knowledge of the Alliance Fleet's location. The Strike cruiser diverted full power to its rear [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] as it fled, which deflected fire from the Rebel commander's pursuing medium transport. However, such a shielding configuration merely left the Strike cruiser's bow exposed, an easy target for the pilots of Rogue Squadron. Rogue Five, whom Antilles had ordered to sweep around the combat zone at the engagement's onset, moved in for a frontal assault,<ref name="SOTE1" /> and the Rogues destroyed the Strike cruiser with a barrage of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]].<ref name="C-3PO" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Princess, I'm altering our course. Just as a precaution. It may mean some delay if you still intend to go to ''Tatooine''.''"<br />"''I understand. The safety of the fleet must come first.|The Rebel commander and Leia Organa, following the elimination of the Imperial Strike cruiser|<ref name="SOTE1" />}}
[[File:AlteringCourse-SOTE1.png|thumb|right|315px|Princess Leia consented to the Alliance Fleet's course change, even though it would delay her plans to rescue Han Solo.]]
Rogue Squadron eliminated the Strike cruiser and its TIE fighter complement while suffering no major casualties,<ref name="SOTE1" /> but the Alliance Fleet's secrecy had been compromised nonetheless.<ref name="C-3PO" /> As a precaution, the Rebel commander altered the fleet's course,<ref name="SOTE1" /> and the armada broke formation and began heading back toward the galactic plane.<ref name="C-3PO" /> The commander informed Leia Organa via [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] aboard the ''Redemption'' that his decision could mean a delay in her plans to rendezvous with Lando Calrissian on Tatooine, but the princess understood that the safety of the fleet took priority over her personal desires, and she reasoned that Luke Skywalker badly needed the extra time in recovering from his encounter with Darth Vader.<ref name="SOTE1" />

A report of the Alliance Fleet's possible location did reach Vader, who intended to follow up on the lead in his continuing search for Skywalker, but [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had other plans for his minion. The [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] ordered Vader back to<ref name="SOTE1" /> the Imperial throneworld<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" /> of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to negotiate shipping arrangements with [[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate as part of the Empire's secret construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="SOTE1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish at Haven appeared as the opening sequence in the [[Shadows of the Empire 1|first issue]] of the [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (comic series)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'']], written by [[John Wagner]] and illustrated by [[Kilian Plunkett]].<ref name="SOTE1" /> The first issue was published on [[May 7]], [[1996]].<ref name="Insider29">{{InsiderCite|29|The Horse's Mouth|Straight from the Horse's Mouth: Creating the Shadows Comic Book}}</ref>

During the comic's development stage, in response to issue 1's first draft, [[Lucas Licensing|Lucasfilm Licensing]] editor [[Allan Kausch]] instructed Wagner to insert into and then eliminate from the battle a Strike cruiser as part of the Imperial forces. Kausch noted that since TIE fighters are not equipped with [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]], they could not have reached the Alliance Fleet's location without a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]]. In addition, Kausch required that the first draft change the line "Ready photon torpedoes!" to "Ready weapons!"<ref name="Secrets">''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref>
